coverImageAlt: A navy vault arch shelters a cyan-linked cluster of operational nodes from four orange pressure wedges.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A substantial protective arch sheltering a connected cluster of operational nodes while controlled threat forms test it from many directions, expressing a comprehensive enterprise IT risk assessment across technical, organizational, financial, and continuity concerns.
Scene/backdrop: Warm-paper terrain plane against deep slate, abstract and architectural rather than digital or screen-based.
Subject: One dominant navy shield-like vault arch over a cyan-linked cluster of varied physical nodes; several small orange pressure wedges press against the exterior while the interior network remains orderly and intact.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; architectural model, matte ceramic nodes, painted wood arch, and subtle structural joinery.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; low frontal view with the sheltering arch forming a bold silhouette; internal nodes large and sparse enough for approximately 290-pixel card width; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: vigilant, calm, capable, quietly technical; cyan interior illumination and sparing orange external pressure points.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: matte painted wood, ceramic nodes, frosted connector rods, warm paper ground, subtle wear.
Constraints: original image; one dominant protection-and-testing metaphor; abstract unmarked nodes only; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: padlocks, hacker hoodies, binary code, server dashboard, branded cloud iconography, generic cybersecurity stock imagery, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Use a completely plain unmarked warm-paper ground with no contour lines; pull back so the full vault arch, all protected nodes, and every threat wedge sit inside the inner 84% with a clear border; reduce the threats to exactly four small sparing orange pressure wedges, all fully visible and touching only the outside of the arch.
